why: Angeltveit and McKay's paper 'R(5,5) ≤ 46' (arXiv Sept 2024, published Journal of Graph Theory 2026) improves the upper bound on R(5,5) from the previous 48 (McKay & Radziszowski 1997) to 46, directly narrowing the known range 43 ≤ R(5,5) ≤ 46.
